title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 6: Wooder
description:
In this episode I fight with the game's water physics while I try and build the Goodhill Water Works.

Here is a good video about the real thing: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ailejQWsq8

The title music is Beethoven's Symphony no. 5 in Cm, Op. 67 - IV. Allegro, performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra.

The cinematics music is Beethoven's Symphony no. 5 in Cm, Op. 67 - III. Allegro, also performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra.

Both are public domain music from Musopen: https://musopen.org/music/2567-symphony-no-5-in-cm-op-67/
